_note: The named sources behind BOSS's practices, lifted from each practice's `provenance:` field so the website can show compact references instead of a wall of prose. URLs are DELIBERATELY null until someone verifies them — BOSS checks who actually said a thing before grading it, so inventing a plausible link here would be the exact failure that step exists to catch. Fill a url in and the website turns that name into a link on the next `npm run gen:site`; leave it null and the name renders as plain text. Nothing breaks either way. Each source carries a `kind` (person | org | research | standard) for grouping, and `key: true` when it is a named practitioner whose thinking is distilled here or a primary spec a reviewer would re-open. ONLY key sources carry a URL obligation — everything else is credited by name and that is enough. Naming everyone is right; linking everyone is busywork.
